caseName: Harrison-Jenkins v. Med. Univ. of S.C.
caseNameFull: Peggy HARRISON-JENKINS v. MEDICAL UNIVERSITY OF SOUTH CAROLINA

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until June 3, 2013, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance *2382with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
